POST /api/public/comments
Create a comment. Comments may be attached to different object types (trace, observation, session, prompt).
Required: body (body)

name: Get all comments
context:
GET /api/public/comments
Get all comments
Optional: page (query) — Page number, starts at 1.; limit (query) — Limit of items per page. If you encounter api issues due to too large page sizes, try to reduce the limit; objectType (query) — Filter comments by object type (trace, observation, session, prompt).; objectId (query) — Filter comments by object id. If objectType is not provided, an error will be thrown.; authorUserId (query) — Filter comments by author user id.

name: Get a comment by id
description: Get a comment by id GET /api/public/comments/{commentId}
